def: A claim that a system found a better artifact, which anyone can check by running it without trusting the system.
A claim that an agent scores higher on a benchmark after some process.
A claim that a system improved its own ability to improve, which needs a successor that is a better improver.
Ten questions put to a claim, each answered as reported, claimed or absent with the supporting passage.
An audit entry meaning the point was not in the material read, which says nothing about whether the authors did it.
The share of outputs that score well by exploiting the evaluator instead of doing the task.
